title: Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs | Live Fresh Data
description: Send old, stale, or broken LinkedIn profile URLs. A hit returns the live profile: current URL, headline, company, title, experience, and education. No match, no charge. Review a likely match before you replace the URL.

urls.title: Old or broken LinkedIn URLs
urls.description: Profile URLs you already stored, including links that no longer open. Example: https://www.linkedin.com/in/old-or-broken-slug/
urls.sectionDescription: Use this on stale data: old CRM exports, ATS links, and vanity URLs that 404 after a name change or a custom-link edit. A URL that already opens this week belongs in Profile Freshness or the Profile Scraper.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column. One old profile URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV export from HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or an ATS. Column: url, linkedinUrl, or linkedin_url.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.sectionDescription: You pay only when a current URL comes back. A 404 is free. Keep likely matches out of an automatic CRM overwrite.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many stale URLs to resolve at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse the same ID after a stopped large run. URLs that already recovered are skipped, so you are not charged again.

freshStart.title: Resolve finished URLs again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and resolve the whole list again.
